name: IDNP (Identification Number of Person)
issuer: the State Register of the Population (R.S.P.)
note: Moldova's sheet (its government's own sheet on the OECD's automatic-exchange portal ('Information on Tax Identification Numbers'; the OECD's index page sits behind a bot check and wasn't opened, the sheet itself came straight back)), read 2026-10-30: the IDNP is assigned to each natural person on the first entry of their data in the State Register of the Population and never changes; 13 digits, 2ГГГXXXYYYYYK (2, the last three digits of the year it was given, the registrar's office, a serial, a check digit by a 'special algorithm' it doesn't give, so `check` is left out); a citizen's tax number is the IDNP on the identity card, and a foreigner's who owes tax is the IDNP where there is one. Read as given on registration (a birth's or a newcomer's first entry), to citizens and residents. The name and issuer are as the sheet gives them, in English.

sources.title: OECD AEOI portal, Moldova: Information on Tax Identification Numbers (the jurisdiction's own sheet)
sources.said: IDNP is assigned to each natural person at the time of the initial entry of data about him in R.S.P. (State ...
